name: finrun
description: Financial research with local Python, a pinned method catalog and evidence-linked reports.

interface.longDescription: Research companies, earnings, industries and financial data. Produce sourced answers, interactive reports or CSV datasheets, and discover topics with Radar. One skill selects versioned financial methods from a public GitHub catalog and uses local Python for evidence records, calculations and checks. Requires a compatible local agent, Python 3.10+, a writable workspace and access to the requested sources. Yahoo market data has an optional dependency. No Finrun account or MCP server is required. Outputs can contain errors and require review; they are not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Analyze NVIDIA's main business and financial risks.
Compare the latest earnings of Microsoft and Alphabet.
Find three financial developments worth researching.
